Aerodynamic_Contour_Feathers.description: A dense, overlapping coat of stiff contour feathers layered over insulating down. They provide a perfectly streamlined, frictionless surface against the air while ensuring excellent thermoregulation at high altitudes.

Cryptic_Downy_Plumage.description: Incredibly soft, velvety feathers lacking the stiff barbules of standard flight plumage. While slightly less aerodynamically efficient, they absorb high-frequency sound waves, rendering the entity's movements and wingbeats completely silent.
